finalText:
Build's clean now — 0 errors, exit code 0.

It wasn't just noise: the bundler bump changed how options get passed in, and two spots hadn't caught up.

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler sends `retryCount`. That was throwing on every build.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated an unset backoff flag as invalid and threw, but the new config loader leaves it `undefined` instead of `false`. Now `undefined` just means backoff's off, same as before.

The rest of the warnings — deprecation notices, tree-shaking notes, dedupe logs — are just noise from the bump and don't need fixing.
